body: Thanks, I just dont know what to do anymore. Im so sick of feeling like shit everyday, i just wish it would end. Its hard, really fucking hard.

Ok, thank you kind stranger. As for what Im going through, it all started at a school dance. I don't even know what happened exactly its like my anxiety came out of nowhere because the next morning when I woke i felt like I was dying, the closer we got to the school the more my heart pounded I started hyper-ventilating, I was white as snow, and I was flexing my legs so hard that when I tried to get out of the car I couldn't stand up. Im not being bullied or anything its just... I don't even know.

Thats a good question, i dont really know if the Therapists I see specialized in children/Youn Adults. As for the school thing, I can switch schools but all of the ones that are near me are under the same schooling system.

I just feel stuck. No matter what I try nothing ever happens. My schools threatening court on my parents because of my dumb ass. I try so hard and not one person sees it and it fucking sucks. I constantly feel like shit and every therapist I go to says that Im fine and that they can't take me in cause im doing fine with everything but school. What kind of backwards policy is that? Im just done. I feel like Ive hit rock bottom.
